text:
incident-bot: SEV2 page — Rivermark (private VPC) multiple endpoints failing; healthchecks flapping on NLB, ~50% request 502s reported by customer. Paging on-call. link: https://redwood.inc/alerts/INC-2026-084

alice.sre: oncall here, taking it. quick context: Rivermark private deployment in us-west-2, dedicated pool pinned to that VPC. NLB target health unhealthy across 3 hosts. seeing 502s + healthcheck 504/timeout.

jordan-ops: I grabbed flow logs — lots of RSTs to probe src 10.10.0.5 around 15:05 UTC. Route53 TTL currently 300 — suggest dropping to 60 while we orbit (doing if we need failover later).

neteng: digging into SG history — there was a recent automation run that tightened a tenant SG and removed the probe CIDR (10.10.0.0/24). That would block internal health probes from the NLB. I'm going to re-add the rule as a hotfix.

neteng: running hotfix now:
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 --protocol tcp --port 8080 --cidr 10.10.0.0/24 --description "allow nlb health probes (temporary revert)"
```

dana-support: Confirmed with Rivermark SRE — they rolled an infra change at ~15:02 that touched tenant SGs. They're standing by and approved temporary revert.

jordan-ops: reverting Route53 TTL to 60 for rivermark-inference.example.com (propagating).

neteng: pushed SG rule, waiting for NLB healthcheck cycles (1-2). verify with: `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:targetgroup/rv-rm-tg/abcd1234`

jordan-ops: describe-target-health shows 3/3 healthy now, 15:18 UTC. upstream 502 rate dropping.

alice.sre: traffic recovering — 95% of endpoints healthy. leaving TTL=60 for 10m, then we'll restore to 300 after stability window.

dana-support: Customer impact summary for account team: ~17% of requests returned 502 between 15:10–15:28 UTC. They want RCA and SLA review.

alice.sre: assigning incident owner: @alice.sre. incident id INC-2026-084. Next steps: postmortem + action items: (1) add automation guardrail to prevent removing probe CIDRs, (2) improve SG change alerting, (3) playbook update for private deployments (NLB health probe checks).

incident-bot: Incident marked acknowledged by on-call. Escalation to neteng recorded. :white_check_mark:

alice.sre: closing handoff — monitoring for 20m then will close. I'll open postmortem doc and loop in acct team. Thanks all. :bow:
summary: Rivermark private VPC NLB healthchecks blocked by recent SG automation change; temporary SG revert restored health and reduced 502s; TTL lowered and postmortem assigned.
